question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution: The correct answer is **"driving."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Driving"** means operating a vehicle or guiding something towards a particular direction. (वाहन चलाने या ड्राइव करने का कार्य) • **Example**:* I got the **driving**__ lessons.* • This word is correct in this context. • The correct answer is option 3. • Correct passage: Indian culture treats guests as God and serves them and takes care of them as if they are a part and __parcel__ of the family itself. Even though we don’t have anything to eat, the guests are never left hungry and are always __looked__ after by the members of the family. Elders and respect for elders is a major component in Indian culture. Elders are the __**driving**__ force for any family and hence the love and respect for elders comes from ______ (4) ______ and is not artificial. An individual takes blessings from his elders by touching their feet. Elders drill and ______ (5) ______ the Indian culture within us as we grow. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Deriving** means obtaining something from a specified source. (किसी निर्दिष्ट स्रोत से कुछ प्राप्त करना) • **Caring** means feeling concern or interest for someone or something. (किसी व्यक्ति या वस्तु के प्रति चिंता या रुचि महसूस करना) • **Diverting** means causing someone or something to change course or turn from one direction to another. (किसी व्यक्ति या वस्तु को मार्ग बदलने या एक दिशा से दूसरी दिशा में मोड़ने के लिए प्रेरित करना) 45:Td8f, The correct answer is **"within."**
